name: Azure
attack_surface: Azure portal login, tenant configurations, key vault access rights, storage accounts ACL
common_misconfigurations: Azure Blob Storage set to public read access
Missing Multi-Factor Authentication on tenant administrators
validation_methods: Attempt reading from blob storage URLs anonymously
Check access privileges on key vaults using Azure CLI options
evidence_requirements: HTTP capture showing successful anonymous download of blobs
Error logs from vault read containing secret metadata keys
false_positive_indicators: Expired secrets or keys that are disabled
Blob storage URLs returning HTTP 403 blocks
reporting_guidance: Blob storage exposure containing personal details is critical focus; TLS issues are low value.
